404.titulo_pagina: This page does not exist — Ander Flow
404.texto: It may be an old link — some tools changed names when the catalog was reorganized. Searching is faster than going back.

403.texto: Your account does not have permission to open this page. If you think it should, talk to the administrator on the notices screen.

429.titulo: You knocked on the door too fast.
429.texto: To protect the site, attempts are blocked for a few minutes. Try again in {minutos} minutes — the tools keep working in your browser.

500.titulo: Something went wrong on our side.
500.texto: The problem was not you. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, search and the catalog usually come back first.
